message: Momiji's first match is finally about to begin.
That's why I came to do a final check of her equipment, but...

name: Momiji
message: 「Mental Resonance Coefficient is the same as usual. No problems there...」
Momiji was handling everything all by herself.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, are you sure you don't need any help？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm？ Sensei, do you want to touch me？ What a pervert~」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not what I meant！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, the Suzakuin Family is all about self-reliance. I basically do everything myself, so I'm fine.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see...」
It's reassuring, yet lonely at the same time—and above all, it leaves me feeling guilty.

name: Momiji
message: 「What's wrong? Why the gloomy face?」

name: Iori
message: 「It's just... in the end, I wonder if I was of any use to you at all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You really don't need to worry about that.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I do worry. I'm ashamed of myself as a teacher.」
I haven't been able to teach her the "state of Shohou Muga," nor can I help her with her fitting.
What purpose did I even serve for Momiji?

name: Momiji
message: 「Jeez, I'm telling you, it's fine.」

name: Momiji
message: 「More importantly, don't make a student who's about to head into a match worry about you~」

name: Iori
message: 「Urk, you have a point... Sorry！」
I shake my head and switch gears.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, you're strong. Having watched you up close, I like to think I know that better than anyone.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, of course. I don't have the slightest intention of losing.」

name: Iori
message: 「Still, be careful.」

name: Iori
message: 「Your opponent, Shizuku-san, uses a pretty unusual Tenju. If it activates, you're going to take serious damage.」
The "Demon Extermination" she uses will be a threat to Momiji. I made sure to tell her about that beforehand.

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, I know. Well, I'll figure something out.」

name: Iori
message: 「I intend to watch over you until the very last moment, but if I judge that it's too dangerous to go on, I'll stop the match. Keep that in mind.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't you dare—if you do that, I'll hold a grudge against you, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's fine with me.」
No matter how much Momiji resents or hates me for it, I don't care. Protecting my students is still my duty as a teacher.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Haah, all right. Only if it really comes down to the wire, okay?」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. I'll never let your hard work go to waste.」

name: Umpire
message: 「―Martial Arts Division, Year 1, Special A―Rank 'Takamura Class'！ Suzakuin... Momijiiiiiiiiiii！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well then, I'm off.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, go get 'em！」
Momiji gave me a smile, and I sent her off with one of my own.
Amidst the cheers, we face each other on the stage—

name: Momiji
message: （Hmm, I wonder how this is going to turn out...）
Minamoto Shizuku—bearer of the Minamoto clan bloodline that exorcises Keyou.

name: Momiji
message: 「Let's have a good match, Minamoto-senpai.」
I give a light bow, yet for some reason Minamoto-senpai remains expressionless. Normally, she'd at least say something back.

name: Umpire
message: 「Both fighters, take your stances！！」
In any case, I draw my Origami at the Umpire's signal. Minamoto―senpai takes her stance as well―

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Suzakuin-san, I'm sorry.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Normally, I don't care whether I win or lose a match, though」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You're the one person I just refuse to lose to...！」
With dark eyes, she turns naked hostility toward me.

name: Momiji
message: （Did I do something to make Senpai mad...？）
No matter how I rack my brain, I can't think of any reason she'd hate me.

name: Umpire
message: 「Gather the eight million gods in divine assembly, deliberate in divine counsel. Purity of heaven and earth, purity of the six senses—exorcise and cleanse, purify...！」
Still, what lies ahead is a main tournament match with no mercy. I steel myself.

name: Momiji
message: （Fine by me—I can't afford to lose either！）

name: Umpire
message: 「In the East, Suzakuin Momiji！」

name: Umpire
message: 「And in the West, Minamoto Shizuku！」

name: Umpire
message: 「—Spirits high! Face off, no false starts!」

name: Umpire
message: 「Fight fair and square—begin！！」
I barely manage to block the sharp strike aimed at my wrist.
The Minamoto-senpai I know wasn't the type to open with a preemptive strike, though...

name: Shizuku
message: 「Haaaaaaaah...！！！」
She presses right into a flurry of strikes.
As soon as I guard against a compact, thrust-like swing, she pulls her blade back and shifts into an upward scooping slash.
And the moment I parry that, her blade flips back as if she'd seen it coming, flowing straight into a diagonal downward slash.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, Shizuku comes out of the gate with a ferocious flurry！ Is that the Matsukaze Itto-ryu stance?！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「That's a form built around combos and mind games. You chain an attack with multiple follow-ups straight into another one with even more branches, finishing your opponent off before they ever get a chance to counter.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Make one wrong read, and she'll end it right then and there！」

name: Momiji
message: （Hmph, trying to play mind games with me—！）
I read her attacks and every single follow-up completely！
I block her horizontal sweep to the torso, read the follow-up leg sweep, and leap right over it as I circle around to her side.
Aiming straight for her wide―open flank, an unavoidable strike―！

name: Momiji
message: 「No way, she stopped it...？！」
She forcefully twisted her body around, bringing her arm out from behind her back to block it.

name: Momiji
message: （But in a reckless posture like that...！）
To break her balance, I go on the offensive this time with a flurry of my own. Yet—

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Whoa, what a stop by Shizuku！ No matter where the attacks come from, she's blocking every single one！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「T-That's... Tokuma-ryu swordsmanship？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「It's a defensive style boasting an ironclad guard from any posture. Wait, that's the complete opposite of the form she was just using？！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「We've heard Shizuku has mastered multiple schools, Sakura-san—that's pretty incredible, isn't it？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Damn right it is！ Normally, it easily takes thirty or forty years just to fully master a single school of swordsmanship, you know？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「And this form in particular demands high-level flexibility, lightning reflexes, and outrageous foresight on top of it！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I've never even seen anyone pull it off in a real match！！」

name: Momiji
message: （Oh yeah? Then a feint to break her stance...！）
Leaving my center of gravity in its original position, I deliberately swing and miss with a weak attack—then unleash the real strike from there！

name: Momiji
message: （Darn, that didn't work either...！）
In reality, she had taken the bait. But even from that position, she still managed to set up a defense.
Such high physical ability, and that power to read moves ahead—I can hardly believe she's from the Technical Division.
It's no wonder she pushed aside the other Martial Arts Division students to make it to the main tournament.

name: Momiji
message: （Nope, she really is a tough nut to crack... what should I do about this~）
—As I thought this and pulled away for a moment.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Analysis complete, now all that's left is to trace it...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Analysis...？」
Minamoto-senpai muttered that and began to take up a different stance.
It's one I recognize—a form I've seen often in front of the mirror.

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't tell me, that's mine...！！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Hm？ Oh, ohhh！？ This is... it's just like a mirror image！ Shizuku-senshu has started imitating Momiji-senshu's form！？」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Hey, hey, you gotta be kidding me...！！ Seriously, this year, it's nothing but people doing crazy stuff！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Even with all the people you've fought, you've never had to seriously face yourself, have you...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Heh, it seems like I'm about to have a valuable experience.」
The moment she entered my range with a sharp dash—she pulled back and struck in the blink of an eye.
Despite not having been in a stance just a moment ago, the blade comes down suddenly. I see, it's quite nasty to be on the receiving end of that.
Since the Origami is the same, I have the advantage in reach. But Minamoto-senpai was increasing her speed to compensate for that.

name: Momiji
message: （She's even adding subtle arrangements to overcome weaknesses, she's got real technique...！）
I strike back as if to drive her away, but she shows no sign of retreating.
Worse, the way she parries and returns strikes uses the same movements as mine, trapping me in the strange illusion that I'm attacking myself.

name: Momiji
message: （...I see, she realized that I excel at reading moves, so she's imitating me to seal that off.）
While analyzing that, I lightly dodge a strike that came in too softly.
Counterattack—I thought, but the instant I did, I felt a bad premonition.
A weak, empty swing. This is what I did just before—

name: Shizuku
message: 「There！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh！？」
I managed to sense it and block it, but Minamoto-senpai had anticipated my defense and countered it.
I stopped just in time, locked blades with her, and pushed against her.

name: Momiji
message: 「Having my own playstyle rearranged like that is a pretty fresh experience...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I mostly understand your sword style...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s truly a great lesson！」
However, Minamoto-senpai remains silent, fixing me with a burning gaze.

name: Shizuku
message: 「For all the times you’ve confused me, I’ll confuse you right back...！！」
Suddenly, Minamoto-senpai sinks her body low. She breaks the blade-lock abruptly, causing me to lose my balance. And then—

name: Shizuku
message: 「Mishima―ryuu Type Kanoe: Gouhou―！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Kyaaah！？」
Sliding in from a low stance to get inside my guard, she delivers a rising palm strike following a ground―shaking stomp―！
Caught completely off guard, my body is sent flying through the air. There’s no need to imagine whose style this is.

name: Momiji
message: 「Setsugekka’s, Mishima-ryuu Martial Arts...！？」
To think she could even copy something like that...！

name: Shizuku
message: 「If it’s necessary, I can be a replacement for anyone...！ Your replacement, or anything else—everything...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「That’s why I don’t need you！！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I’ll defeat you and prove it...！」
I don’t understand what she’s so angry about.
I don’t understand, but it seems her anger is directed at me.

name: Momiji
message: （……Huh, I see.）
Things like this have happened before.
I’ve seen countless people who vent their resentment at the Suzakuin name.
I didn’t think Minamoto-senpai was that kind of person, but... well, it doesn’t matter now.
To begin with, I have no intention of losing to anyone.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Haaaaahhh！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Player Shizuku is launching a rush here！ Pure god-speed！ That’s one flowing barrage！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Meanwhile, Player Momiji is forced onto the defensive! Is it difficult to fight against your own style?」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「I mean, setting aside your average dojo, Momiji’s style is quite unique.」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Plus, if you try to attack carelessly, she’s got that martial arts training. It’ll be interesting to see how Suzakuin handles this！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Mishima―ryuu Type Hinoto: Enga―！」
I lift my body to match her powerful kick, absorbing the impact as I parry it.
Truly, it is a devastating power that reminds me of Setsugekka from back then.
That must be the result of an extraordinary analytical eye. She has collected and analyzed every single shred of information.
And the behavioral patterns she has deduced, she makes her own, reproducing them with her own body.

name: Momiji
message: （Thinking about it... maybe I'm a little like her）
Such is Minamoto-senpai's combat prowess—powerful and ruthless.
However, I have no intention of losing—if we are on the same playing field, I won't lose even more so.

name: Momiji
message: （If Minamoto―senpai analyzes and reproduces, I will analyze and turn it into the ultimate strategy reading―！）
Minamoto―senpai's combat style, I will read it through to the very end―！

name: Momiji
message: （Divine Eye Ultimate Hand, activate...！）

name: Shizuku
message: （It's coming...！）
Suzakuin's eyes suddenly grew sharp.
According to my analysis, this is a technique that constructs and traces an extremely accurate and peerless reading for a limited amount of time.
“This alone” was the one thing I simply could not reproduce.

name: Shizuku
message: （But I have analyzed her, and even if I can't reproduce it, I should be able to deal with it...！）
No, I must.
If I can't handle it, I'll lose, and if I lose, it's all over.

name: Shizuku
message: （That is the only thing I absolutely refuse...！！）

name: Momiji
message: 「...Here I come！」
Suzakuin moves in to attack.
Think. Anticipate. Use everything I have grasped so far to escape from her clutches...！
The initial body sweep, woven with a feint, was successfully avoided.
As for the follow-up thrust, I managed to parry the first strike, but I couldn't evade the second.
As I backed away, Suzakuin saw right through it and pursued me relentlessly.
And it was as if she knew the exact moment I would stop—I can't stop！

name: Momiji
message: 「I’ll end this right here！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Aghhh...！」
The fifth move, the sixth, the seventh, the eighth...
No matter how much I rack my brain, and even estimating based on the behavioral patterns I thought I had mastered.
Everything is seen through, mastered, and I am being carved up as she pleases.
Anything I do is futile. That fact is thrust right before my eyes.

name: Shizuku
message: （Why... why, why...！！）
I can become anyone. I should be able to take anyone's place.
And yet, she calmly does things that I cannot...！

name: Shizuku
message: （I can't forgive this... this is all wrong...！）

name: Momiji
message: 「Ninth move, middle stance—！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ghhhuuaaaaaaaah！」
Her blade, carving into my flesh.
From it, I feel a vile—a black, wicked power of darkness.

name: Shizuku
message: （This... must be purged...！！）

name: Momiji
message: 「Tenth move, with this—！」
The moment I thought it was the final blow—

name: Shizuku
message: 「I can't forgive you... I won't forgive you, never...！！」
Minamoto―senpai's Origami began to shine―！

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, ghuuuuuu...！」
A feeling of revulsion so strong it’s unbearable to look at, followed by a wave of lethargy. And then, nausea hits me.

name: Momiji
message: （It’s out, the Keyou Killer...！）
I can feel the power of my Tenju rapidly waning.
I wanted to take her down before she could activate this, but I didn't make it in time.

name: Shizuku
message: 「I’m going to take you down right here...！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh... ngh...！」
I manage to barely block the slashes Minamoto-senpai is hammering me with.
The attacks themselves are quite ordinary, but they are heavy, so heavy.
Even so, it’s not that Minamoto-senpai has gotten stronger. It’s because the protection of my Tenju has diminished.

name: Momiji
message: （Oh, come on, the naginata is so heavy...！）
I never thought a day would come when I’d struggle just to swing a naginata.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Still more—I won't let it end with just this...！」
Minamoto-senpai is, of course, relentlessly hammering me with combos.
I don’t know what she’s so angry about, but this is really bad.
I’m struggling just to block, and the more I block, the more I’m affected by this “Demon Extermination” influence.

name: Momiji
message: （Ghuuu... I'm running out of options...！）
Suddenly, Minamoto-senpai’s eyes flashed sharply.

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh no...！」
My sixth sense warned me—Senpai is pulling something. I scramble to retreat, but it’s too late—

name: Shizuku
message: 「—Secret Selection, Swallow Triple Strike！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh-aaaaaaah！！」
My Barrier Jacket was gouged deeply, and I was sent tumbling and crashing onto the ground.
As I rolled along the dirt, I gritted my teeth and forced myself onto my knees.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Woooooaaaah！ Momiji-senshu has taken a brutal hit here！」

name: Momiji
message: （You’ve got to be kidding, copying my Swallow Tri-Strike…！）
She should have only seen it once when she fought Victoria, yet the replication was flawless.
Perhaps that’s why. I had managed to deflect the first and second strikes, somehow.
That said, overcoming all of them was impossible. My Barrier Jacket was heavily damaged.
If she uses it again—I absolutely won’t be able to weather it.

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Now, Shizuku-senshu！ This is your chance for a follow-up！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Wait… oh? I wonder what happened. Shizuku-senshu has stopped in her tracks.」

name: Momiji
message: （Hm？ No follow-up…？）
Puzzled, I managed to lift my head.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Haa… hah, haa… haaaa…！」
There stood Minamoto-senpai, her shoulders heaving painfully as she gasped for air.

name: Momiji
message: （Ah, I see… she’s out of stamina…！！）
Minamoto-senpai is in the Technical Division.
Third-year students enter specialized tracks and stop doing basic physical training like the Martial Arts Division.
Tenju can only augment things like arm strength or leg power; it cannot compensate for actual physical stamina.
Furthermore, Tsubame Gaeshi requires an extreme reallocation of Tenju, demanding massive, instantaneous muscular power.
Even I, who am used to it, can't just fire it off repeatedly. It drains your stamina like nothing else.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ha, ha… not yet, it’s not over yet…！！」
If Minamoto-senpai had been able to challenge me in peak condition right now,
with my Tenju weakened by Demon Extermination, I would have been defeated without any recourse.
But, if Minamoto―senpai is just as drained―

name: Momiji
message: （There’s still a chance for me to win…！）
Will my Tenju run out, or will Minamoto-senpai’s stamina give out? From here on, it’s a battle of willpower.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ha, haa, I don’t want to give up… in a place like this…！」
Minamoto-senpai glared at me, her breathing ragged.

name: Momiji
message: 「…Minamoto-senpai, what have you been so angry about this whole time?」

name: Shizuku
message: 「You… you probably wouldn’t understand…！」
Senior Minamoto attacks in one breath. Her blow is heavy; there's no chance to even attempt a counter.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Being by her side... was supposed to be my place...！！」
'Her'... could she be talking about Victoria?
With a ferocious―and somehow pained―look, the senior rushes toward me.

name: Shizuku
message: 「And yet, to talk of going solo like that...！！！」
The impact was so great that I nearly lost consciousness.
Senior Minamoto continues her onslaught, screaming in grief all the while.

name: Momiji
message: （...Ah, so that's it.）
The reason Senior Minamoto looked at me with such dark eyes when I explained the 'going solo' idea to Victoria—
I finally understood the source of the senior's rage.

name: Shizuku
message: 「I've changed since I met Vicky...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I always thought I was better off alone, but now, I can't think that way anymore...！！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Before I knew it, being by Vicky's side had become my place...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「There's no going back now, you know...！！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「And yet！ If that's taken away from me！ What am I supposed to do...！！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, nnngh...！！」
This is bad, my Barrier Jacket won't hold out much longer...！

name: Momiji
message: 「Senior, that's just misdirected anger...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes, I know that...！ Suzakuin-san, you've done nothing wrong...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「But I don't have the courage to say this directly to Vicky...！ That's why this is just taking it out on you...！」
To Victoria, Senior Minamoto was a reliable, important partner.
And Senior Minamoto, in turn, took pride in being relied upon by Victoria.
She didn't want that relationship to be destroyed—.

name: Shizuku
message: 「This is just misdirected anger... but that's not all there is to it.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「If you lose, the idea of going solo will fall to the ground...！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「And for that very reason... you're going to fall right here！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aghhh！！」
Senior Minamoto's blade, which I failed to parry, tears my Barrier Jacket to shreds.
Amidst the shock—I finally understood the senior's feelings, and my lips curled into a faint smile.

name: Momiji
message: （If it were the me from a little while ago, I might not have understood...）
But now, I somehow get it.

name: Iori
message: 『No... in the end, I wonder if I was of any use to you』

name: Momiji
message: （That's... obvious, isn't it）
I smile at the face and the words that surfaced in my mind.
Sensei pulled me out of my shell. He was overbearing and stifling, and at first, I thought he was annoying.
But thanks to him pulling me along anyway, my world has changed completely.
Thank you, Iori―sensei―

name: Momiji
message: （...I could never say that to his face, though！）

name: Shizuku
message: 「With this... fall！」
I plant my staggering feet and take the follow-up blow.
Even just that is whittling away my Tenju. Between the sense of loss and the fatigue, my body feels heavier than if it were flesh and blood.

name: Momiji
message: 「Minamoto-senpai... I understand how you feel...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I also have people precious to me, and a place that's precious to me...！！」
Mustering all my remaining strength, I strike back at Senpai.

name: Momiji
message: 「Hah, hahh...！」
Breathing is painful. I’ve reached my limit.
There won't be another chance.
If I'm going to move, it has to be now—
Yes... this is my last chance！

name: Momiji
message: （Shingan no Kiwamete, activate...！！！！）
Look closely.
Look, feel, and discern—！
Where does my victory lie?
First move... second move... third, fourth...！

name: Shizuku
message: 「I won't let you... absolutely not！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I will win... I can't end it here！！」

name: Shizuku & Momiji
message: 「Secret Selection, Swallow—！！！" "Secret Selection, Swallow—！！！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Triple Strike—！！！」
In that split second, our Origami clash, sparking as if they’re spitting fire.
I’m gripped by the illusion that I’m facing myself, that I’m trying to strike down my own self.
But I’m already beyond that point.
Beyond that, to one step further—！

name: Momiji
message: 「Fourth strike！！！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaaah...！」
That final slash caught Minamoto-senpai.
It shaved away the last of her Barrier Jacket... and at the same time, the Keyou-slayer's power came to a halt.
My Tenju—was still barely holding on.

name: Umpire
message: 「...Match decided！！！」

name: Umpire
message: 「In the West, Minamoto Shizuku's Barrier Jacket is confirmed destroyed！」

name: Umpire
message: 「Therefore, victory goes to the East, Suzakuin Momiji！」
The Umpire's announcement and the crowd's cheers echoed across the stage.

name: Momiji
message: 「I-I won...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Man, that was way too rough...！」
Enveloped in the cheers―I collapsed spread―eagle right then and there.
